item.title: 'I'll miss it;' Wilmington bids farewell to longest-serving council member - WWAYTV3
item.description: Charlie Rivenbark, Clifford Barnett and Luke Waddell will step down as three new city council members are sworn in.

item.title: Leland Police Department needs help identifying man - WWAYTV3
item.description: The Leland Police Department is asking for the public's help with an investigation.

item.title: Carolina Beach man held without bond after son’s killing as prosecutors push first-degree murder charge - WWAYTV3
item.description: Carolina Beach Police are actively investigating a homicide that occurred this weekend. Robert Strauss Davis made his first virtual appearance in New Hanover County Court Monday, initially charged with second-degree murder for shooting and killing his son -- Andrew Tyler Davis.

item.title: Carolina Beach urges residents to secure Freeman Park pass discounts amid ongoing nourishment work - WWAYTV3
item.description: Carolina Beach officials are reminding residents about Freeman Park's parking pass deals, even though the nourishment project is under way. Residents and property owners of Carolina Beach are being offered certain deals on parking passes for Freeman Park.

item.title: Federal review finds 44% of US trucking schools don't comply with government rules - WWAYTV3
item.description: Nearly 44% of the 16,000 truck driving schools in the U.S. may be forced to close if they lose their students after a review by the federal Transportation Department found they may not be complying with government requirements.

item.title: Son of drug kingpin ‘El Chapo’ pleads guilty in US drug trafficking case in a plea deal - WWAYTV3
item.description: One of the sons of notorious Mexican drug kingpin “El Chapo” pleaded guilty on Monday to U.S. drug trafficking charges, months after his brother entered a plea deal.

item.title: Doctor says Trump had preventative screening MRI on heart, abdomen with 'perfectly normal' results - WWAYTV3
item.description: Donald Trump' s doctor says the president had MRI imaging on his heart and abdomen in October as part of a preventative screening for men his age, according to a memo from the physician released by the White House on Monday.

item.title: Brunswick County Commissioners discuss fire services, unanimously approve two resolutions - WWAYTV3
item.description: Commissioners also heard information about fire services in the county, with a new contract between the county and fire departments expected to be presented by county staff at the January 20th meeting.

item.description: Another Monday means another time to count down the top three performers from the week prior in the latest installment of Winning Ways.

item.title: NCDOT holds hearing on proposed Independence Blvd extension project - WWAYTV3
item.description: More than 100 people gathered at the GLOW Academy in Wilmington for the hearing and to learn more about the project.
